claims.claim: **Management depends on whether the tooth is primary or permanent.** Primary teeth: **never replant, splint or reposition** — observe or extract them.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Replanting permanent teeth or fragments needs urgent management** to improve long-term viability.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Do the primary and secondary survey first** where required — dental trauma often comes with facial and head injuries. ⚠️ **In infants and young children with oral trauma, consider child abuse.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Time since injury matters** — a knocked-out (avulsed) permanent tooth is a dental emergency. Ask about first aid (rinsing, wet or dry storage) and tetanus status.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Account for every lost tooth and fragment**; if any are missing, examine the chest and oral soft tissues for aspiration or embedding. **Chest X-ray if aspiration is suspected.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Lift the lips firmly** to find gingival or mucosal injury — degloving is missed otherwise; a swollen tender chin suggests mandibular degloving.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **OPG for children over 3 years who can cooperate** if a mandible fracture, TMJ injury or fully intruded tooth is a concern.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discuss with the emergency dental service** and send an intraoral photograph where possible; they decide between emergency specialist care and community dental referral.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Prophylactic antibiotics after replantation of an avulsed tooth**, for soft-tissue injuries with debris, or when operative management is needed. Give a tetanus booster if required.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Swab 0.12% chlorhexidine mouthwash on twice daily for 10–14 days** to lower infection risk; a soft diet lets loose teeth firm up.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Concussion** (tender but firm): community dentist; usually heals without intervention. **Subluxation** (tender, loose, blood at the gum): emergency dental service if very loose.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Lateral luxation, extrusion or intrusion:** emergency dental service. Primary teeth are monitored or extracted; permanent teeth are usually splinted or repositioned, under general or local anaesthetic.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Avulsion:** make sure the tooth is not fully intruded (an X-ray may be needed), then refer to the emergency dental service. **Primary: do not reinsert.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Avulsed permanent tooth:** store in **milk (first choice) or saline**; **never water, never scrub it**; handle the crown only, not the root.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **If possible, return it to the socket** and bite on gauze, supported with alfoil. **Best prognosis if dry time is under 20 minutes.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Enamel or enamel-dentine fracture:** community dentist. **Pulp exposed (pink and painful):** emergency dental service — a primary tooth will likely be extracted; for a permanent tooth, keep fragments in milk for rebonding.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Crown-root fracture** (may be an aspiration risk) **and root fracture:** emergency dental service.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Supporting bone:** check the bite, OPG, refer to dental and maxillofacial; **follow up every mandibular or maxillary fracture, even undisplaced.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Degloving injuries and deep tears need operative cleaning, debridement and suturing** to reduce osteomyelitis risk.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Crown discolouration is common and may resolve**; extraction only for pulp infection or abscess.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Transfer** if specialist dental or maxillofacial care is not available locally; **discharge** once intervention is complete and follow-up is arranged.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Dental trauma' (Last updated July 2024), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Dental_trauma/, retrieved 2026-09-23
